top_signals.title: StanChart’s Englander Betting Against Yen ‘Short-Term’
top_signals.summary: Steven Englander, global head of G10 FX research at Standard Chartered Bank, citing the strength of the US dollar and uncertainty about future rate-hiking commitments from the Bank of Japan, says that he wants to bet against the yen “short-term.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Howard Buffett to succeed father Warren as Berkshire Hathaway chair
top_signals.summary: Conglomerate says the elder Buffett will step down as chair and take on role of chair emeritus
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Short-Term Treasury Borrowing Costs Jump in Repo as Yields Surge
top_signals.summary: The cost to borrow key short-term Treasuries is jumping as investors load up on certain recently issued securities to set short positions, a move that could support next week’s US government debt auctions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Drone strikes and noise disputes: The soaring risks of the global data centre boom
top_signals.summary: As data centres scale, consume more power, and draw tighter community scrutiny, insurance risks are becoming increasingly complex. As AI infrastructure grows, so do legal risks: large lawsuits involving data centres more than tripled from four in all of 2021 to 14 in the first half of 2026, according to a Howden report.
